episodes.title: Life Today in Former German 🇩🇪 Cult In Chile 🇨🇱 Colonia Dignidad Villa Baviera
episodes.description:
🇨🇱🇩🇪 This is What Life is Like Today in Colonia Dignidad Villa Baviera
Once Known As Colonia Dignidad, This Remote German Compound In Chile Has One Of The Most Chilling And Complex Histories In South America. Founded In The 1960s By German Immigrants Led By Paul Schäfer, It Became Infamous For Abuse And Secrecy. But I Wanted To Show What Life There Is Like Now.

Today, The Settlement, Renamed Villa Baviera, Is Trying To Move On. In This Video, I Explore What Life Is Like There Now: How Former Residents Live, The Stories They Tell Me And How The Community Balances Tourism With A Dark Past. I Speak German With The Residents And Spanish With The Chilean Staff.

From The Bavarian-style Restaurant, Supermarket, Museum And Hotel, Villa Baviera Is A Place Unlike Anywhere Else. With Its Sad Past I Show How It's Now Beautiful Calm And Peaceful.
